findings.explanation: Both the invoice and the receipt cite PO-1005, but no purchase order document exists anywhere in the transaction evidence, so the authorization basis for the 59,000.00 INR spend cannot be verified.
Receipt REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice INV-1005 it references (2026-07-21), an out-of-sequence ordering that the otherwise consistent amounts do not explain.
